=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | Line or code reference: `detect_pushes()` function, lines 926-950, specifically the final conditional `if not pushes and not any(getattr(i, "subcommand", "") == "push" for i in invocations) and _UNPARSED_PUSH_RE.search(command): return [(cwd, "HEAD")], ""` and the preceding `tips = [...]` / `pushes.extend(...)` lines.
  PROBLEM: Tag-only pushes produce no stamp check because `_push_targets` drops tag refs and the fallback is prevented when a push invocation was parsed.
  WHY: A tag push can publish an unstamped commit without a confirmation prompt.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | Line or code reference: `detect_pushes()` loop, lines 935-947, specifically `tips = [t.tip for t in guard._push_targets(invocation, directory) if isinstance(getattr(t, "tip", None), str) and t.tip]` and the unconditional `pushes.extend((directory, tip) for tip in tips)`.
  PROBLEM: Bulk pushes produce a synthetic HEAD target, so the hook checks only HEAD's stamp and does not enumerate other published branches.
  WHY: A bulk push can publish an unstamped branch tip despite a passing HEAD stamp.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | Line or code reference: `plan_units()` function, lines 546-548 (the `elif style == "pytest" or pytest_ok:` branch) versus the sibling branch at lines 549-556.
  PROBLEM: The configured-pytest branch schedules pytest without checking whether pytest is importable.
  WHY: When pytest is missing, both PR and merge-base runs fail as inherited and `run_gate` can return `pass`, allowing a push even though no test ran.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py | Line or code reference: `_UNPARSED_PUSH_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![\w-])git(?:\s+-[cC]\s+\S+|\s+-\S+)*\s+push\b)` at line 923, used in the fallback branch at line 948.
  PROBLEM: The regex is applied to the entire raw command without honoring shell quoting or heredoc bodies.
  WHY: A commit message or PR body containing `git push` can cause an unwanted confirmation prompt on a non-push command.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Hardening suggestion, `detect_pushes()` return statement, after line 950: When the guard parses a push invocation but `_push_targets` returns no usable tips, there is no observability explaining why the push was not blocked. Suggested change: emit a structured log line for parsed pushes with no tips. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
